text: dsh-beads-panel 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Beads 任务面板，在左侧栏提供工作区任务图谱入口。它通过 Host 本地接口调用 Beads 的 bd 命令，支持按可领取、进行中、待处理和全部任务筛选，查看任务详情、依赖与评论，并在面板内新建、领取或关闭任务。适合在 DSH 工作区中直接管理 Beads issue。使用前需安装 Beads CLI（bd），并在目标工作区初始化 Beads 数据库；可通过 BEADS_BIN 指定 CLI 路径。

dsh-beads-panel adds a Beads issue panel to the DSH Web sidebar. It uses the bd CLI to filter workspace issues, show details and comments, and create, claim, or close issues. Install bd and initialize Beads in the workspace first; BEADS_BIN can set its path.
想在 DSH 左侧栏直接浏览 Beads 任务并按状态筛选。
能不能在 Harness 里查看某个任务的描述、依赖和评论？
希望不用离开 DSH 面板就能创建、领取或关闭 Beads issue。
dsh-beads-panel 的功能「筛选与查看任务」：在侧栏面板选择工作区后，可按可领取、进行中、待处理或全部筛选 Beads issue，并展开查看单项详情和评论。
dsh-beads-panel 的功能「管理任务」：通过面板表单输入标题、优先级和类型创建 issue，也可领取选中任务或关闭任务并填写可选原因。

dsh-beads-panel README · Beads panel for DeepSeek Harness：[](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/liupack/dsh-beads-panel)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that
puts [Beads](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads) into the Web GUI's left
sidebar panel list.

The panel works on a Harness workspace's Beads database (`bd`):

dsh-beads-panel README · Beads panel for DeepSeek Harness：- **Ready / In progress / Open / All** filters over the workspace's beads.
- Inline detail for one bead: description, notes, dependencies, metadata, and comments.
- **New bead** form (title, priority, type).
- **Claim** and **Close** actions on the selected bead.
- Graceful states for "bd is not installed" and "this workspace is not a `bd init` project yet".

dsh-beads-panel README · About Beads：[Beads](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads) is a distributed, dependency-aware
issue tracker for AI agents, powered by Dolt. Agents use the `bd` CLI
(`bd ready`, `bd update --claim`, `bd close`) to keep a structured memory
instead of markdown TODO lists. This plugin reads and writes that same database;
it does not copy state anywhere.

dsh-beads-panel README · How it is built：| Half | File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `index.js` | Serves `GET/POST /__dsh_beads/api` (owner-authenticated). Resolves a registered workspace id through the Host workspace registry and runs one fixed `bd` invocation per action. |
| Client | `client.js` | Registers the `beads` entry in `sidebar.panellist` and the matching `main` panel. Renders the list, detail, and forms; every data operation goes through the Host half. |

dsh-beads-panel README · How it is built：The Browser half never runs a shell: a request can only select one of the closed
actions `status`, `issues`, `issue`, `create`, `claim`, and `close`, and only the
Host owns the workspace directory and the `bd` argument vectors.

dsh-beads-panel README · Install：Requires the Beads CLI (`bd`) on `PATH` (or set `BEADS_BIN`), for example:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gastownhall/beads/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

Install the published bundle from npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-beads-panel
```

Install this checkout as a local bundle instead (from a Harness session with
Full access):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/LiuPack/dsh-beads-panel.git
```

dsh-beads-panel README · Install：```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<absolute path to this checkout>
```

Then pick **Beads** in the left sidebar panel list. To remove it:

```
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-beads-panel
```

dsh-beads-panel README · Use：- The panel inspects workspaces registered with the Harness, and remembers the
  last one you picked. Run `bd init` in the workspace to create its Beads
  database.
- `bd` is looked up through the Host subprocess service first, then
  `/opt/homebrew/bin/bd`, `/usr/local/bin/bd`, `~/.local/bin/bd`, and
  `/usr/bin/bd` (set `BEADS_BIN` to override).
- Write actions are queued because embedded Dolt allows one writer.
- The UI is localized (English and Simplified Chinese), uses only Harness theme
  tokens, and ships its own icon.
